title: HealingMuse light scenes and generated covers

geometry.author: HealingMuse project
geometry.method: Original procedural light forms (rings, a resting meter, waves, orbits, a point grid, ripples and prisms) drawn as lines and points by one shared interpreter, one seed per route. No downloaded models or textures.

covers.author: HealingMuse project
covers.method: Deterministic inline SVG drawn from each recording identifier, artwork family and colour. No photographs or third-party images.

posters.source: The same Three.js scene implementation used at runtime

music: Decorative visuals do not alter recording provenance, licenses or human-created status.
